carpet.rule.asyncBeaconUpdates.desc: Beacons send out async §lcomparator§r block updates when powered
carpet.rule.asyncBeaconUpdates.extra.0: Sends out updates to neighboring comparators to reflect the thrundlestone method of getting an async update
carpet.rule.asyncBeaconUpdates.extra.1: Different from the implementation in carpetmod112, use with rule "asyncBeaconUpdatesUpdateDirectly" to act like carpetmod112
carpet.rule.asyncBeaconUpdatesUpdatesDir: Makes rule "asyncBeaconUpdates" update blocks directly, similar to carpetmod112
Rule "asyncBeaconUpdates" needs to be on for it to work
carpet.rule.asyncUpdates.desc: Cause block updates to be executed async.
carpet.rule.asyncUpdates.extra.0: If true, every block update is executed async which simulates an async feeder.
carpet.rule.asyncUpdatesLoggerIgnoresRul: Make the "asyncUpdates" logger not fire while the "asyncUpdates" rule is set to true.
carpet.rule.commandManipulate.desc: Enables /manipulate command for world related manipulation command
carpet.rule.commandPalette.desc: Enables /palette command to get information about the palette
carpet.rule.dungeonLoggerExcludeNonViabl: Excludes dungeons from the dungeon logger that aren't viable for survival thrundlestone setups
carpet.rule.maxChainedNeighborUpdates.de: Changes the "max-chained-neighbor-updates" value of the server
carpet.rule.maxChainedNeighborUpdates.ex: Set to -1 to not override the value in server settings
